ابرغششن (form IVq)
# اِبْرَغْشَشْنَ (ibraḡšašna) /ib.raɣ.ʃaʃ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# اِبْرَغْشِشْنَ (ibraḡšišna) /ib.raɣ.ʃiʃ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
